results.name: Mazda MX-5 Miata Hardtop LOW POLY
Kobold Trap_Setter-Female
results.description:
New Drop: Low-Poly Kobold Trap-Setter Female (PS1 Style)

Expanding the devious dungeon dweller roster on the storefront. Here is a clean, highly stylized low-poly homage to classic PS1-era RPG enemies with this female variant of the Kobold Trap-Setter.

The Specs:

Style: True retro PS1-era low-poly geometry with classic pixelated textures. Captures the cunning reptilian aesthetic perfectly with her green scaly skin, draconic snout, tattered rags, and a heavy utility belt loaded with tools and pouches for her deadly contraptions.

Optimized: Ultra-lightweight with classic segmented joints, making it perfect for mobile, VR, or retro-inspired indie RPG and adventure projects.

Game-Ready: Set in a standard T-pose, scaled to real-world proportions, and ready to drop right into your engine's treacherous dungeons and trap-filled caverns.

results.name: Assassin-female
results.description:
New Drop: Low-Poly PS1-Style Female Assassin

Expanding the retro roster with a lethal touch. Here is a classic, 32-bit inspired low-poly female assassin character model, utilizing those iconic unfiltered pixel textures for a perfect PlayStation 1 era aesthetic.

The Specs:

Style: Authentic retro 3D aesthetic. Combines a blocky, ultra-low polygon count with crunchy, pixelated textures for that genuine late-90s grit.

Character Design: Suited up for stealth, featuring a green hooded tunic, lower face mask, a distinct braided hairstyle visible beneath the hood, a leather utility belt with pouches, rugged boots, and a back-mounted sword.

Optimized & Game-Ready: The model is presented in a standard T-pose, making it perfectly primed for rigging and animation pipelines.

Use Case: Ideal for retro demakes, nostalgic 3D platformers, old-school stealth action games, or classic RPGs.
